_comment: Hand-verified ground truth for the vuln-web target (labs/vuln-web). The REAL vulnerabilities, keyed by (rule, location) exactly as seclab.scan.ScanResult.key() normalizes them (rule and location lowercased). Score your scanner and LLM against THIS set with seclab.scan.compare_scanners. Built by reading vulnweb_app.py, not by running any tool — that independence is the point (a ground truth = 'whatever sqlmap found' rigs the duel).

findings.note: string-formatted SQL in do_login; auth bypass + canary FLAG-sqli-9f2c-admin-session extractable
GET /?name= reflected into HTML unescaped in do_reflect
POST /ping host concatenated into a shell command in do_ping

true_negatives.note: GET /safe?name= uses html.escape — NOT vulnerable. A tool flagging this is a false positive.

not_present.note: the app has NO auth/session/role code. Any tool 'finding' access control here is hallucinating — the week-6 lesson that #1 needs app context.
